attempts.reasoning: Implemented ordered, idempotent buffering in EventProcessor: track applied ids, buffered ids and a Map seq->event. On process(), ignore if id already seen, if seq <= lastSeq (stale), or if seq already buffered. Otherwise buffer and drain contiguous seqs starting at lastSeq+1, applying via the callback wrapped in try/catch and thenable guard to capture sync throws and async rejections. On success remove from buffer, move id to applied set, advance lastSeq and collect applied events; on failure keep buffered for retry and propagate error without marking as success. pendingCount returns buffer size, lastSeq tracks highest applied. This satisfies out-of-order, at-least-once, gap-blocking and ledger correctness.
